text:
nina: FYI eu1 started showing increased 5xx after the morning deploy (model-redwood-3.2.1). Small customer-facing spike. Need fast decision: region-pin or rollback image?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: eu1 5xx=10.8% over 8m. Canary fraction 12%. Suggested actions: pin to model-redwood-3.1.9 or rollback image. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback

ryan: Quick triage: GPU mem pressure in traces; tokenization hint shows new tokenizer path may allocate more.

qa: Smoke suite queued; can run quick 10-case check if we pin.

ops-lead: Threshold met. Approve expedited regional pin to v3.1.9. Notify CS about potential minor output diffs.

nina: Issuing command now: `/deploy pin model-redwood-3.1.9 --region eu1 --skip-canary --reason "5xx spike after 3.2.1"`

deploy-bot: Pin accepted. Preflight OK. Rolling to 100% in eu1 with safety ramp.

qa: Smoke checks: all green. No obvious semantic regressions in 10-case set.

deploy-bot: Pin complete. 5xx dropped to 0.7% over 3m; p95 latency normalized.

releasebot: Draft note created: "Emergency region pin in eu1 to v3.1.9 due to elevated 5xx following 3.2.1 rollout. Investigation ongoing. Postmortem: INC-3468."

ops-lead: Keep region pinned for 2h and collect heap/gpu dumps. Assign follow-up owners.

nina: Filing INC-3468 and will own telemetry collection. Closing fast-path thread unless issues surface.
